description: This file defines kernel package configurations for the Broadcom 2835 SPI controller drivers within the OpenWrt build system. It includes package definitions for the main BCM2835 SPI controller and the auxiliary SPI controller, specifying their compilation options, kernel module files, dependencies, and descriptions.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines a kernel package configuration for including driver build options, files, dependencies, and descriptions.

methods.name: $(eval)
methods.description: Evaluates and executes the configuration call for each package defined.
